plan.study: Separately preregistered local JMdict prefix-selector component screen
plan.scope: Local sequential native compressed-source inflation + per-bank CRC + strict parsing + completed lookup component only. No complete browser import, storage, compression, UI, release, process-memory, equivalence or PR claim.
plan.authorizationBoundary: Preparation only. The exact plan/controller and a fresh no-arguments resource snapshot require parent plus independent benchmark review before invocation. No observation exists at freezing.

childPolicy.gcBetweenWarmupsAndMeasuredPass: Unchanged runner calls exposed globalThis.gc once outside its clocks

workload.inputCache: Existing verified compressed archive via a filename symlink; no new archive or decoded-corpus copies

analysis.unit: One complete measured corpus pass in one fresh child
statistics: all same-code changes and largest absolute control change
analysis.controls: Retain every outlier. Noisy or overlapping same-code changes make attribution inconclusive; no control subtraction or adjusted speed claim.
analysis.failures: Keep every raw stdout/stderr/status, completed observation and resource snapshot. A failure stops this cohort as incomplete; never replace or silently resume a child.

plan.sourceAndLibChecks: Verify both Git identities, complete materialized source/lib inventory, runner/lock/archive/Node hashes and inherited Node environment before and after every child. Abort on drift without replacement.

compileProvenance.provenanceLimit: Original build/six smoke modes passed but that original job later failed lint; this recovery does not turn that job into a completed qualification.

priorExcludedMechanics.scope: Mechanics/output expectation only, not a timed observation or a clean candidate product run

resourcePolicy.teamLocalCpuWorkSuspendedDuringMeasureme: Parent, benchmark reviewer and glossary investigator must acknowledge the window before invocation
resourcePolicy.backgroundVisibility: Process names/states only, no arguments or environment-secret dump. ps sees the current execution namespace and cannot prove whole-host quiet. lscpu and cgroup counters are unavailable here; failure/nulls are retained, with available /proc model/affinity/memory/load facts. Shared-host contention remains a limitation requiring explicit review before measurement.
resourcePolicy.snapshots: Before/after every child and cohort; retain all without selecting or replacing timings
